title: AI Rubber Hose
description: Transforms the photo into a classic 1930s rubber hose cartoon illustration.
positive_prompt: Transform the input photo into a classic 1930s rubber hose cartoon illustration. Reimagine all visible people, animals, objects, and the surrounding environment in the visual language of early hand-drawn theatrical cartoons. Use smooth rhythmic ink outlines, rounded simplified anatomy, flexible tube-like arms and legs, expressive oval eyes, vintage cartoon facial construction, exaggerated yet recognizable expressions, and playful flowing shapes. Apply a restrained black, white, and warm gray palette with subtle aged-film grain and traditional ink-and-paint cel aesthetics. Preserve the original clothing designs and identifying details in vintage cartoon form rather than replacing them with generic costumes. Rendering contract: Use the input image as visual ground truth. Keep the exact number of subjects and their left-to-right order, relative scale, pose, gaze, interaction, perspective, and composition. For every visible person, retain recognizable face geometry, identity, recognizable facial traits, approximate age, hairstyle, clothing, and characteristic silhouettes identifiable while stylizing anatomy with rubber hose conventions; do not beautify, age, or swap identity unless explicitly requested. Maintain the left-to-right arrangement, major props, environmental context, original camera viewpoint, and source aspect ratio. Apply the transformation consistently throughout the entire image to the subjects, clothing, props, and environment. Return one coherent finished image, not a before-and-after comparison, split screen, unintended collage, or animation sequence; output a single finished static cartoon frame with no readable text, dialogue bubbles, letters, numerals, logos, signatures, watermarks, or interface elements.
